name: lovitations
description: Make your wedding website, digital invitation or save-the-date on Lovitations in the chat, the way the site's start does: your names, date and photo, then choose a style shown with your own names. Plus wedding planning skills: wording, guest list, RSVP follow-up, seating plan, schedule, budget and speeches.

interface.longDescription:
Lovitations makes digital save-the-dates, wedding invitations and wedding websites for couples marrying in the Netherlands, with a personal link for every guest and a live RSVP overview.

**Make your page in the chat.** The same start as on lovitations.nl: your names, your wedding date and a photo of the two of you. Then choose your style from the Lovitations templates, each shown with your own names, date and photo. You get the link to your page and finish it in the Lovitations editor.

**Manage it in the chat.** With your page's editor link (and its PIN, if you set one): see who is coming and who has not answered yet, get the numbers for the caterer, and add or change guests.

**Plan the wedding.** A first budget from the Lovitations 2026 Dutch wedding cost model, and help with invitation wording, website texts, a guest list with day and evening guests, a seating plan, a schedule for the day and speeches, in your language.

**Good to know.** Nothing is sent to your guests: you share their links yourself. The venue, programme, RSVP questions and colours are set in the Lovitations editor, not in the chat. Managing a page needs its editor link, so keep that link private or protect the page with a PIN. Lovitations and its cost model are made for weddings in the Netherlands.
defaultPrompt: I want to make our wedding website on Lovitations.
How many guests have answered our invitation so far?
What does a wedding with 50 day guests and 100 evening guests cost?
